_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: On a phone, selecting rendered commit text offers a selection comment and adds its quote to the chat draft. window.selectTextIn(selector, text) selects text within an element. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. The heading ".diff-commit-message-content h2" reads "Polish mobile preview". Eval window.selectTextIn('.diff-commit-message-content h2', 'mobile preview'). The button "Comment selection" becomes visible. Click it. The ".diff-viewer-comment-dialog" is visible and its ".diff-viewer-selected-text" reads "mobile preview". Fill ".diff-viewer-comment-input" with "Please clarify" and press the comma and period keys while the input is focused; its value is "Please clarify,.". Click the dialog's "Add Comment" button. The dialog disappears. The value of [data-testid="message-input"] contains "> mobile preview" and "Please clarify,.", but does not contain "> Polish mobile preview". Select "body excerpt" in ".diff-commit-message-body" with window.selectTextIn; "Comment selection" becomes visible. Click it and verify the dialog's selected text reads "body excerpt".
